$comment: Repo-wide defaults, and the marker dv walks up the directory tree to find. Its presence is
what makes 'dv' work from any folder inside the repo.
Everything that belongs to ONE PowerApps solution lives beside that solution's code under
pluginsDirectory - not here. This file only holds what is true for the whole repo.
$comment_output: Where 'dv pack' writes the .zip. '{solution}' is replaced with the solution name.
Overridden per solution by 'packageOutput' in its solution.json, and per run by --out.
$comment_default: Used when a command names no solution and the working directory is not inside one.
Leave it out to force -s whenever the repo holds more than a single solution.
